title: Minuteman silos on Black Hills land guaranteed by the Fort Laramie treaty

tellings.quote: 150 Minute Man silos were sunk into land that was guaranteed to the great Sue Nation by the 1868 Fort Laram treaty.

plain: According to Jesse Michels, 150 silos for Minuteman nuclear missiles were sunk into land in the Black Hills of South Dakota that had been promised to the Great Sioux Nation by the Fort Laramie Treaty of 1868, an agreement between the United States and Sioux tribes. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, while telling a story about Air Force veterans, as a reminder of whose land these weapons sit on.
